verdict.rationale: Bento can be driven without its UI. It ships a CLI with 50+ commands for managing the whole account (search, CSV import, broadcasts, transactional sends). It also has a REST API using HTTP Basic key auth and first-party SDKs, and it explicitly pitches scripting recurring jobs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/non-interactive usage docs (e.g. env-var auth for the CLI, CI pipeline examples), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
